youtube.baslik: Why can a threshold shift continue while foam earplugs are used? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: One of the most common causes of a shift is a protector that is worn wrongly or used irregularly. In the example case, the worker is asked to insert the earplug in front of the audiologist, and the plug stays only at the canal entrance; a foam plug should be rolled into a thin cylinder and inserted deep into the canal while the pinna is pulled up and back. The way to measure real protection, rather than guess it, is individual fit testing; even taking the protector out for short periods during a shift clearly reduces effective protection.
